meta.title: Academic Commission - Doctorado en Inteligencia Artificial

main.body:
Academic committee

The composition and functions of the Academic Committee of the PhD Programme are established in articles 4 and 5 of the PhD model of the Polytechnique University of Madrid

The Academic committee of the PhD Programme in Artificial Intelligence (CAPDIA) is presided over by the Programme Coordinator and composed of the UPM professors participating in the programme.

Currently, the composition of CAPDIA can be seen in this file.

Quality system

The ETSII’s Internal Quality Assurance System (SAIC) is designed according to the guidelines of the AUDIT programme and with the collaboration of the Vice-rectorate for Quality and Efficiency of the UPM.

  • Quality at the UPM
  • Internal Quality Assurance System (ETSII)
  • Quality Committee (ETSII)
  • Technical Quality Unit (ETSII)
  • Deputy Director of Quality and Accreditation (ETSII)
